reason: createPageMetadata (lib/metadata.ts) requires description: string, so a call without it fails tsc, but the only outlier, compare/page.tsx, does not call the helper at all (R5): it hand-builds Metadata to point at the dedicated /api/og/compare image (a separate ImageResponse design in api/og/compare/route.tsx), which the helper cannot express because it hardcodes /api/og?title=... with no image option; compare/[slug] does the same for the same reason, so pages with a custom OG route are a recurring legitimate variant and the count is 0 of 1 (R2). Hesitated with ACCEPT if one treats compare as drift that should have extended the helper; not TRIVIAL since the counted outlier is not caught by types or biome.
